question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"based."** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Based"** is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.
 
• It means **"founded on" or "having its basis in." **(एक स्‍थान को आधार-स्‍थल बनाना जहाँ से यात्रा आदि गतिविधियाँ की जा सकें)
 
 
• **Example:** *The company's success is **based**__ on its innovative ideas.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct passage:

The figure of Arthur first appeared in Welsh poetry in the __late__ sixth and early seventh centuries, a hero who was __said to__ lead the Britons in battle against Saxon invaders. But it wasn’t __until__ the 12th century that he was first tied to this dramatic headland, known as Tintagel.

The timeless popularity of the Arthur legend has overshadowed a central, unresolved __question__: Was there really a King Arthur, or at least a historical prototype upon whom Geoffrey's hero is __based__?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "caged"**, means confined or trapped. (पिंजरे में बंद)
 
• **Option 3, "hanged"**, means suspended by the neck until dead. (मरने तक गर्दन से लटकाया गया)
 
• **Option 4, "found"**, means discovered or came across. (किसी संगठन, संस्‍था आदि की स्‍थापना करना)
